Learn Abyssal Engine

This is the main human-readable hub for learning how Abyssal is built and how to build with it.

The editor is the workshop. The manual is the textbook. Start here when you want the path through projects, assets, Fragments, gameplay, editor tools, and rendering.

Common Mistakes

  • Trying to save authored content without opening a project first.
  • Assuming a Fragment's color determines Team. Team is structured ownership data; match context can override Fragment defaults.
  • Editing a placed instance and expecting the source Fragment asset to change.
  • Expecting runtime-spawned units to be saved into the Scene.
